sources.snippet: A Kaggle NLP project that fine-tunes DistilBERT to classify IMDB movie review sentiment, and adds an interactive semantic review similarity explorer built on sentence embeddings.

sources.title: Sentiment_Classification_using_DistilBERT.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a small, fast, cheap and light Transformer model trained by distilling Bert base. It has 40% less parameters than bert-base-uncased, runs 60% faster while preserving over 95% of Bert's performances as measured on the GLUE language understanding benchmark.

sources.snippet: This repository contains a Jupyter Notebook that demonstrates how to fine-tune the DistilBERT model on the IMDb movie reviews dataset for sentiment analysis. The notebook utilizes Hugging Face Transformers, datasets, and Comet ML for experiment tracking.
